title: Jingzhida FY2025 financial disclosures
definition: Original company financial disclosures from the FY2025 annual-report vintage, including source-reported historical annual comparatives and FY2025 quarters.
limitations: Annual flows, quarterly flows and dated stocks must not be summed. Statement totals/components overlap; 19 same-source equivalents are aliases, not additional evidence.

title: Jingzhida FY2025 operating disclosures
definition: Source-defined IP, R&D-project, workforce, business breakdown, production/sales/inventory, cost and concentration rows from the FY2025 annual report.
limitations: Breakdowns and totals overlap. Source-native semiconductor-memory-test and new-display-device-inspection groups are not complete ATE allocations. Named R&D projects are financial scopes, not maturity records.

title: Jingzhida FY2024 consolidated financial disclosures
definition: Company consolidated financial headlines, quarterly metrics, nonrecurring items and statements in the FY2024 annual-report vintage.
limitations: Flows, dated stocks, quarters and alternate reporting precision are non-additive. Parent statements are excluded. FY2023 cash-flow components differ from the printed net change by CNY0.01; original values retained. Total operating revenue and sales revenue are overlapping source concepts, not additive.

title: Jingzhida FY2024 standalone parent financial disclosures
definition: Issuer standalone parent BS/IS/CF statements in FY2024 annual-report vintage, separate from consolidated group.
limitations: Overlaps economically with consolidated company financials; cannot be summed with them. Annual flows, dated stocks, totals and components are non-additive.

title: Jingzhida FY2025 reported orders and product capabilities
definition: Source-qualified order values, memory-test business growth and separately scoped product/project capabilities from annual-report pp21–24.
limitations: Orders are not recognized revenue or backlog. Delivered products and development targets have different maturity; clock frequency, interleaving and data rate are distinct. Display inspection lies outside semiconductor inspection. Company self-claims, not independent corroboration.

title: Jingzhida FY2024 operating disclosures
definition: Source-native project R&D, IP, workforce, concentration, business/product/geographic/sales-channel financials and operating volumes from the FY2024 annual-report vintage.
limitations: Reporting groups, project totals/components and industry/product/geographic/channel views overlap. Equipment volumes belong to printed mixed business groups, not individual ATE models. Customer/supplier rank is period-specific and supplier concentration is not foreign content.

title: Jingzhida FY2024 source-table cost components
definition: FY2024 source-vintage current/prior component amounts, source-table-total shares and reported relative changes, retaining industry/product presentations.
limitations: Industry/product presentations overlap and must not be summed together. Shares divide by the aggregate source-table cost total, not by the displayed business subtotal. Two printed current-period dashes remain missing; tiny source rounding differences are retained.

title: Jingzhida reported contracts and tester progress
definition: Source-specific announcement amounts, capability comparisons and expected delivery bound.
limitations: Mixed metrics and tax bases; not an additive contract/order/revenue series. Annual-report repetitions overlap these announcements. Signature dates are document context, not publication or event dates. Company claims only.
